title: Emotions in Simulation-Based Education Through the Eyes of the Colour Monster.
summary: Learners in simulation-based education (SBE) experience a kaleidoscope of emotions, which shape learning, performance, and professional identity formation. This article provides a conceptual commentary of the emotional landscape in SBE, using the children's book The Colour Monster as an illustrative lens, while also highlighting the complexities of emotions in adult learners. Lessons drawn from this book highlight that feeling emotions is a normal and expected part of the learning process, the critical importance of the facilitator in helping participants work with their emotions, and the potential role of emotional regulation strategies in optimizing emotions for learning and performance. Deepening appreciation of these concepts may facilitate more consistent appreciation and integration of emotion into simulation design and delivery.

标题：模拟教育中的情绪：以《彩色怪物》为视角
摘要：模拟教育（SBE）中的学习者会经历丰富多样的情绪，这些情绪塑造了学习、表现和专业身份形成。本文以儿童绘本《彩色怪物》为阐释视角，对模拟教育中的情绪图景进行概念性评述，同时强调成人学习者情绪的复杂性。该书带来的启示强调：感受情绪是学习过程中正常且预期的一部分；引导者在帮助参与者处理情绪方面具有关键重要性；情绪调节策略在优化学习与表现相关情绪方面具有潜在作用。加深对这些概念的理解，可能有助于在模拟设计和实施中更一致地重视并整合情绪。
关键词：模拟教育；情绪；情绪调节；引导者；专业身份形成
